hook: Google just launched Gemini 4 Carbon with a temporary price cut.

sections.voiceover: Google just launched Gemini 4 Carbon with a temporary price cut.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of the Gemini 4 Carbon logo on a clean white background.
b_roll: Studio shot of Gemini 4 Carbon logo

sections.voiceover: On November 10, 2026, the company made this model publicly available to developers. Will Google DeepMind keep these introductory rates of $2 input and $10 output after launch?
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing a calendar marked November 10 and a price tag graphic.

sections.voiceover: Standard costs will eventually double for every user of the platform.
sections.visual_cue: Simple rising graph line showing a doubling trend.

sections.voiceover: Once the introductory period expires, Google raises the price to $4 per million input tokens. Koray Kavukcuoglu confirmed these standard rates will replace the introductory pricing after the period ends.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison chart showing the jump from $2 to $4 and $10 to $20.

sections.voiceover: The standard rate will be $4 for input and $20 output.
sections.visual_cue: Final text card displaying the permanent rates.
